# Azure Functions Cookbook

> Dogfood-tested recipes and patterns for the Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit.

A curated, runnable collection of Azure Functions Python v2 patterns — from HTTP APIs to durable orchestration — that also dogfoods the Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit (openapi, validation, logging, scaffold, db, and more). Use it as a reference for idiomatic, production-shaped Azure Functions code.

## Foundations
- [Execution Model](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/foundations/execution-model/): How the Python v2 model runs.
- [Triggers & Bindings](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/foundations/triggers-bindings-overview/): Overview of triggers and bindings.
- [Pattern Chooser](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/foundations/pattern-chooser/): Pick the right pattern.
- [Delivery Guarantees](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/foundations/delivery-guarantees/): At-least-once and idempotency.
- [Hosting & Scale](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/foundations/hosting-and-scale/): Plans and scaling.

## Patterns
- [Patterns Overview](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/patterns/): All recipe categories.
- [APIs & Ingress](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/patterns/apis-and-ingress/): HTTP, auth, webhooks, CRUD.
- [Scheduled & Background](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/patterns/scheduled-and-background/): Timers and queues.

## Reference
- [Reference Overview](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/reference/): Per-trigger reference.
- [Service Matrix](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/reference/service-matrix/): Trigger/binding support matrix.

## Guides
- [Scaffold Quick Start](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/guides/scaffold-quick-start/): Bootstrap a project.
- [Deployment Patterns](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/guides/deployment-patterns/): Ship to Azure.
- [Testing Patterns](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/guides/testing-patterns/): Test your functions.
